notes.title: Quality of Life and Bug Squashes
notes.content:
Quality Of Life

Player

 Increased jump power
 Lowered in-air jetpack recharge timer
 Increased shot speed


UI

 Added End Level button to Pause Menu


Bugfixes

 Fixed issue in pause menu where opening Controls Menu and exiting out of Controls Menu with ESC wouldn't reactivate previous menu's buttons.

notes.title: Player Death Bug
notes.content:
Bug Fixes


 Attempted to fix the bug again, where the player would die if the song ended after reaching the top of the tower.

notes.title: Music and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Additions


 New music for Yule Tower level


Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug where player would die after waiting for music to run out on Yule Tower
 Yule music now properly selects everytime level is loaded

notes.title: Yule Update
notes.content:
Happy Yule!

Coming up quickly on Yule and the Winter Solstice! To celebrate, I've made the Yule Tower that you can now climb to your heart's content!

Beware! The Frost Giants have attacked with a frozen snowball that's hurtling toward Yule Tower! Can you reach the top before it's too late?

Bug Fixes


 Collider fixes on multiple objects
 Menu fixes on buttons that weren't functioning
